_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
The uploaded recording is retained when its delayed draft fails after stopping. The page fakes the microphone, screen capture and MediaRecorder, and window.__recordingMock counts what the page asked for (read it with eval, e.g. "window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts"): displayRequests (screen captures requested), synchronousDisplayRequests (those requested inside a click or keydown handler), microphoneRequests, audioSources, recorderStarts, recorderStops and stoppedTracks (media tracks stopped). "The recording state" is the data-state attribute of ".recording-status". The browser's draft creations are held back until call "releaseDraft", then fail with "draft unavailable". Recording uploads (POST /api/upload/raw) succeed with the path /tmp/shelley-uploads/orphaned.webm. Message submissions are accepted without being sent on, and call "chats" counts them. The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /new. Fill the message input with "Context that stays after the failed draft.". Click the voice button.
2. The recording state should become "recording".
3. Click the stop button. The recording state should become "stopping".
4. Call "releaseDraft".
5. [data-testid="recording-retained"] should become visible, and ".status-error" should contain "Retry with /transcription /tmp/shelley-uploads/orphaned.webm".
6. The cancel button's accessible name (its aria-label) should be exactly "Discard recording". Click it.
7. The message input should have the value "Context that stays after the failed draft.", and call "chats" must return "0".
